entities.summary: Amin Ahsan Islahi, was a Pakistani Islamic scholar best known for his Urdu exegesis of the Quran, Tadabbur-i-Quran, which he based on Hamiduddin Farahi's, idea of thematic and structural coherence in the Qur'an.
